bullets.text: XChat Expands Access - **X**'s encrypted DM feature is now available to more users, enhancing privacy in messaging.
Google Photos Gets Veo 3 - **Google** Photos now allows users to create high-quality videos from images with its new AI model.
CarPlay Enhances Messaging - **Apple**'s iOS 26 introduces tapbacks support for **CarPlay**, improving user interaction.
AirPods Pro 3 Launching Soon - New **AirPods Pro 3** expected to feature upgraded noise cancellation and a new design.
iPhone 17 Pro Rumors - The upcoming **iPhone 17 Pro** may feature improved thermals for better battery life and display.
Lenovo's Legion Go 2 Revealed - **Lenovo** announces the **Legion Go 2**, a powerful handheld gaming device priced from $1,099.
WhatsApp Status Gets Close Friends - **Meta** introduces a Close Friends feature for **WhatsApp Status**, enhancing user privacy.
AI-Powered Hiring by OpenAI - **OpenAI** is launching an AI-driven hiring platform to compete with **LinkedIn**.
Waymo Expands Robotaxi Service - **Waymo** receives clearance to offer robotaxi rides at San Jose airport, enhancing its service network.
GE Invests in Electric Aviation - **GE Aerospace** invests $300M in **Beta Technologies** to develop hybrid-electric aircraft technology.
